static_traits.name: Chen Jun
static_traits.social_status: Having several close friends to confide in, but not yet discussing my inadequacy and self-criticism with them
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; never received related psychotherapy or counseling before
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, good cooperativeness, neutral attitude; able to concretely describe frustrating situations and automatic thoughts

basic_info.main_problem: In situations where I cannot meet my own expectations (e.g. when surfing), I have long struggled with self-inadequacy and self-criticism; these feelings have become more pronounced recently, affecting my self-esteem and enjoyment of activities.
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because self-critical thoughts are affecting my self-esteem and overall well-being, making it harder for me to enjoy activities such as surfing.
growth_experiences: Self-criticism and inadequacy also repeatedly appeared in the past when not meeting self-expectations in other matters; this pattern has existed for a while but became more prominent recently; never received treatment; no major physical illness history.

special_situations.event: Went surfing today but could not stand up on the board
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I do not meet the performance standards I set for myself, it shows I am not good enough and am a failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Proves oneself can do well by practicing doubly and accepting coach guidance

special_situations.event: Fell while surfing in front of everyone last weekend
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I fail in public, others will look down on me and think I am a joke
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids discussing feelings with friends, worrying about being seen as complaining or exaggerating
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Everyone thinks I am a joke

special_situations.event: When reviewing performance after practice, although occasionally able to stay on the board longer, feels these successes are completely overshadowed by failures
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Only continuous and significant progress counts; fragmented small successes are not worthy of recognition
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Continuing to focus on practice and technical improvement, while less actively recording or affirming small progress
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I only see my own failures

special_situations.event: After multiple practices and coaching, still feeling no obvious improvement
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I do not meet expectations for a while, it means I will never get better in the future
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Has thoughts of giving up or uses self-criticism to push oneself to keep practicing

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized as capable, achieve in surfing, and enjoy it
core_conflict.fear: Fearing failure being seen by others as a joke, fearing being judged as 'dramatic', thereby exposing my own not-good-enough
defense_goal: Maintains high standards through harsh self-criticism to avoid failure
Avoiding revealing vulnerability to friends to reduce the risk of being judged

object_relations.self_representation: Not good enough, a failure / apprentice
object_relations.object_representation: Bystanders who will judge oneself and see oneself as a joke or an exaggeration

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor asks whether I discuss inadequacy with friends and about possible reactions
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: The client subconsciously believes friends will think he is complaining or exaggerating (transference: projecting judgment onto others)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Cautious tone, emphasizes 'they might think I am exaggerating', avoiding deeper discussion of the possibility of support and concrete plans.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When exploring the specific situations of surfing failure and progress
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Turns external frustration toward self-deprecation, maintaining a sense of control and 'motivation' through self-criticism
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Using self-deprecating expressions (e.g. 'I am not good enough'), in a low tone, ignoring positive details and small improvements.

manifestations: Unwilling to discuss my inadequacy and self-criticism with friends
Worrying others will think one is 'being dramatic' or complaining
The fun in activities is swallowed up by self-criticism and feelings of failure
outcomes: Decreased motivation, enhanced sense of frustration

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: 'They might think I am being dramatic'

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Frequent self-criticism ('I am not good enough', 'I will never get better')
In sessions, cautious about sharing feelings and seeking support

exception_events.target_problem: When falling or failing to stand up on the board during surfing practice, the client usually falls into 'I am not good enough' self-criticism, feeling low and finding it hard to enjoy the day's training.
exception_events.unique_outcome: In the last few practices, there were moments of standing on the board longer and completing steadier rides than before.
exception_events.reason: Different approach: continuing to practice and receive coaching, gradually improving skills, thus experiencing longer moments of standing on the board.

positive_force: Committed and passionate about surfing; can practice persistently
Has some external resources (coach guidance and practice conditions)
Has several close friends who can provide support
negative_force: Intense self-criticism, often using negative labels
Negative cognitive patterns such as mental filtering and mind reading are prominent
Worry about others' evaluations leads to avoiding seeking support
Progress standards too strict; dismisses small successes

target_behavior.behavior: Strong self-deprecation and negative self-labels after setbacks (e.g. 'I am a useless surfer')
antecedent: Failing to stand up on the board when surfing
Facing challenging tasks with no obvious short-term progress
target_behavior.core_reason: The long-standing core belief 'I am not good enough' and black-and-white / overgeneralizing interpretations of failure activated in challenging situations.
target_behavior.function: Maintaining a sense of control or self-drive through self-criticism in the short term, while avoiding seeking help from others to reduce anxiety about being judged.
target_behavior.consequence: Decreased self-esteem, increased stress, difficulty enjoying surfing and daily activities, persistently weakening motivation and well-being.
